talent-review.title: Talent review
talent-review.purpose: Evidence-based performance and potential review: managers place their people, HR calibrates, the HR director locks the cycle.

talent-review-insights.title: Talent review insights
talent-review-insights.purpose: HR aggregates of placements; every cell under 10 people is suppressed, including women and Emirati splits.

talent-review-pool.title: HiPo pool
talent-review-pool.purpose: High-potential people from locked review cycles, with nominations to ESTADAD through the Leadership Academy.

talent-review-cycle.title: Review board
talent-review-cycle.purpose: Place people on the 3×3 grid next to their evidence: skills, validated check-ins, opportunities, learning agility and shared aspirations.

talent-review-calibration.title: Calibration session
talent-review-calibration.purpose: HR facilitator view across managers: distribution, rater patterns and outlier flags; adjustments with reasons; lock by the HR director.

my-development-priorities.title: My development priorities
my-development-priorities.purpose: Development priorities agreed for you in talent review. Your placement is confidential and never shown.

talent-succession.title: Succession planning
talent-succession.purpose: Succession slates for critical and leadership roles: readiness horizons, hard gates, gap actions, risk flags and bench roll-up.

talent-succession-slate.title: Succession slate
talent-succession-slate.purpose: One slate: successors with readiness and gates, emergency cover, candidates with reasons and confirmation.

common.confidential: Confidential: talent review data is visible only to your scope, never to the person reviewed, and every view is audited.

box.caption: Nine-box grid: potential by performance, with the people placed in each box

anchor.agility: Learning agility: learns fast and applies it

agility.1: Needs repeated support to apply new procedures or systems.
agility.2: Picks up new tasks at the expected pace.
agility.3: Masters new systems quickly and helps others learn them.

influence.2: Coordinates with peers and shares knowledge in the crew.
influence.3: Leads pre-job briefs, coaches others and is sought out for advice.

drive.2: Takes on extra work when asked.
drive.3: Volunteers for stretch assignments and owns the outcome.

ev.title: Evidence panel
ev.desc: Facts from Kafa'a records, so the placement rests on evidence rather than opinion alone.
ev.indexSub: 0 to 100, from skills and evidence as of {date}
ev.growthHint: Skills with fresh evidence, not self-claimed
ev.opportunitiesHint: Gigs, rotations and shadowing with signed-off evidence
ev.agilityHint: Skills brought to their key level in 12 months

reasons.index: Evidence index {n} of 100 (integer points per component)
reasons.breadth: {n} skills at level 2 or above: {pts} points
reasons.depth: {n} skills at level 3 or above: {pts} points
reasons.growth: {n} skills with fresh evidence in 12 months: {pts} points
reasons.validated: {n} skills validated by a manager: {pts} points
reasons.agility: {n} skills brought to their key level in 12 months: {pts} points
reasons.gate_licence_met: Licence route met ({req}, licensee register mirror)
reasons.gate_licence_not_met: Licence route not met: needs {req} (licensee register mirror)
reasons.gate_route_not_met: An entry condition is not met ({req})

flag.external_cover: Depends on KHNP or contractor cover

flagHelp.potential_high_evidence_low: Potential is placed at high but the evidence index is in the bottom third of the cycle: discuss the evidence at calibration.
flagHelp.potential_low_evidence_high: Potential is placed at low but the evidence index is in the top third: check for overlooked potential.
flagHelp.no_ready_now: Nobody on this slate could step in today. Build at least one ready-now successor or name emergency cover.
flagHelp.successor_overloaded: At least one successor is counted on more than two slates, so the bench is thinner than it looks.
flagHelp.external_cover: Emergency cover relies on KHNP secondees or contractors. KHNP support ends by 2030 (per source): plan internal cover.
flagHelp.no_emergency: Name who covers the role at short notice.

gate.none: No hard gate for this role

hub.intro: Review cycles per organisation unit. Placements rest on an evidence panel; HR calibrates across managers and the HR director locks the outcome. Employees see only their agreed development priorities.
hub.howDirector: You read every cycle, review calibrated outcomes and lock cycles. You cannot lock a cycle you calibrated or placed people in (maker-checker).
hub.howHr: You facilitate calibration: compare distributions across managers, discuss outliers, adjust with a reason and finish the session for the HR director.
hub.howManager: Place each person in your team on the grid while the cycle is open. Look at the evidence panel first; a note is required when you depart from the HR rating.
hub.none: No review cycle in your scope
hub.noneBody: When HR opens a cycle for your unit it appears here.
hub.calibratedOn: Calibrated on {date}: awaiting the HR director

board.allPlaced: Everyone in your view is placed
board.calBody: Placements now change only through the HR facilitator.
board.calDone: Calibration finished on {date} by {name}. Waiting for the HR director to lock.
board.lockedBody: Development priorities are published to employees; the HiPo pool feeds ESTADAD nominations.
board.notPlacedBody: The evidence panel below is live; the snapshot is taken when you place.
board.openBody: Place each person in your team. The evidence panel shows what Kafa'a knows; a note is required when you depart from the HR rating.
board.openBodyView: Line managers are placing their people. You can follow progress here.
board.viewScope: Your scope, of {n} in the cycle

place.actionsDesc: Up to {n}. They become the employee's agreed priorities when the cycle is locked.
place.confirmBody: Place {name} in box {box}? The evidence snapshot is saved with the placement and the change is audited.
place.customPh: For example: shadow the outage control room for two weeks
place.hipo: Enters the HiPo pool when locked
place.noteHint: Optional. Visible to HR and in calibration, never to the employee.
place.noteRequired: Required: explain why performance differs from the HR record (10 characters or more).
place.title: Place {name}

sugg.hipo: High potential with at least solid performance: the ESTADAD path, a leadership rotation and a senior mentor are the usual next steps.
sugg.validated: Fewer than two skills validated by a manager: a skill check-in turns claims into validated evidence.
sugg.opportunities: No completed opportunity yet: a gig or project builds evidence outside the day job.
sugg.growth: Little fresh evidence in 12 months: the Learning Coach ranks courses that close the top gap.
sugg.delivery: High potential but below expectations on performance: regular coaching on delivery.
sugg.support: Low box: an agreed support plan with frequent check-ins.
sugg.depth: Deep skills: sharing them builds influence and protects knowledge.

pool.feedBody: A line manager nominates a pool member through the Leadership Academy; HR decides the nomination (maker-checker).
pool.intro: People placed in boxes 8 and 9 when this cycle was locked.
pool.nominateBody: Nominate {name} for ESTADAD? HR decides the nomination; the nominee is notified.
pool.none: Nobody in the HiPo pool in your view
pool.noneBody: The pool fills when a cycle is locked.
pool.pageIntro: High-potential people from locked talent review cycles, in your scope.
pool.reason: Why this nomination (10 characters or more)

cal.adjustBody: Currently box {box} with an evidence index of {index}.

blocker.not_calibrated: Lock opens once the HR facilitator finishes calibration.
blocker.maker_checker: You calibrated or placed people in this cycle, so another HR director must lock it (maker-checker).

apply.title: Apply calibration changes
apply.body: Apply {n} adjustments? Each is recorded with its reason in the placement history and the audit log.

finish.title: Finish calibration
finish.body: Apply {n} staged changes and mark every placement as calibrated? The HR director can then lock the cycle.

lock.title: Lock the cycle
lock.body: Lock this cycle? Decisions can no longer change; development priorities are shared with employees and the HiPo pool is created. This is recorded in the NEXUS ledger.

cal.distributionNote: Staged adjustments are already reflected. There is no forced curve: use the distribution to start the conversation.
cal.facilitatorBody: Compare managers, discuss the flagged outliers, stage adjustments with a reason, then finish calibration. The HR director locks the cycle.
cal.intro: HR facilitator view across managers: the distribution, rater patterns and outlier flags (placement against the evidence index).
cal.lockedBody: Locked by {name}. Decisions can no longer change.
cal.outliersDesc: Deterministic: potential 3 with an evidence index of {low} or less (bottom third), or potential 1 with {high} or more (top third).
cal.ratersDesc: Placements by manager against the evidence of the people they placed.
cal.reasonHint: Required, 10 characters or more. Recorded in the placement history.
cal.viewOnlyBody: HR facilitates calibration; you can see the session for your scope.

ins.allSuppressedBody: Fewer than {n} placements: every figure is suppressed.
ins.gridNote: Cells under {n} people are suppressed, including the women and Emirati splits. No names are ever shown here.
ins.intro: Aggregate view for HR: counts only, suppressed below the minimum group size.
ins.minGroup: Shown only for groups of {n} or more

my.footer: Talk about these priorities in your next career conversation.
my.howBody: After each talent review your manager and HR agree development priorities with you in mind. Ratings and grid placements stay confidential to the review; what matters for you is the plan below.
my.intro: Development priorities agreed for you in talent review.
my.noActions: No specific actions were recorded this time; agree them in your next career conversation.
my.noneBody: They appear here when a talent review cycle for your unit is locked.

sx.atRiskSub: No ready-now, overloaded or external cover
sx.candidatesDesc: People in the role and in feeder roles, ranked by computed readiness (F05 skills and gates). Ready now needs every hard gate.
sx.confirmBody: Confirm this slate with {n} entries? Ready-now successors are re-checked against the hard gates. Recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
sx.confirmedBody: Changes go into the next period. Confirmed slates count in the bench roll-up.
sx.coverDesc: Role cards only (never a named person): who covers at short notice while the internal bench is built.
sx.coverHint: External cover is a role card, for example a KHNP secondee or a contracted technician. It never counts towards the internal bench.
sx.emergencyHint: One emergency cover per slate; naming a new one replaces the previous one.
sx.functionViewBody: You see the slates for roles in your own function, read-only. HR maintains them.
sx.gateBlocked: Ready now is not possible: a hard gate (licence route, qualification or entry condition) is not met.
sx.intro: Person-level slates for critical and leadership roles: readiness computed from skills and gates and confirmed by HR, gap actions per successor, risk flags and the bench roll-up into workforce analytics.
sx.noCandidates: No candidates in the role or its feeder roles
sx.noSuccessors: No successor on this slate yet
sx.noneBody: HR has not opened slates yet.
sx.noneFunction: No slate covers roles in your function.
sx.noteEarlier: Required: you chose an earlier readiness than the computed one (10 characters or more).
sx.proposeBody: Computed readiness: {r}. You confirm the horizon; an earlier one needs a reason.
sx.rollBody: Writes the confirmed slates of critical roles into the workforce bench counts for the period: ready now as qualified, 1 to 2 years as in training, 3 to 5 years as pipeline.
sx.rollConfirmBody: Update the critical-role bench counts for {period} from the confirmed slates? Audited and recorded in the NEXUS ledger.
sx.successorsDesc: Readiness is computed from skills and the role's hard gates and confirmed by HR. Gate chips: green met, red not met.
sx.withdrawBody: Withdraw this entry from the slate? Give a reason of 10 characters or more; it is audited.
